ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The image shows two similar tilted quadrilaterals. The smaller blue quadrilateral is labeled with area A = 27 ft^2, and its corresponding dashed vertical height is labeled x ft. The larger green quadrilateral is labeled with area A = 147 ft^2, and its matching dashed vertical height is labeled 14 ft. Reasoning: Since the figures are similar, the ratio of their areas equals the square of the ratio of corresponding lengths. The larger-to-smaller area ratio is 147/27 = 49/9. Therefore the larger-to-smaller linear scale factor is sqrt(49/9) = 7/3. The corresponding heights satisfy 14/x = 7/3. Solving gives x = 14 * 3/7 = 6.
